verdict.en: A throwaway starter bag: use it for free runs, then trade it to Lance for a Mk. 1 augment.
verdict.zh: 免费的起步背包：跑完免费局，再找兰斯换成 Mk. 1 强化。

use.en: It only takes a Light Shield, has no Safe Pocket and a small weight limit, so treat it as a way to learn the maps without risking gear. Anything you can't afford to lose should not ride in this bag.
use.zh: 只能装轻型护盾，没有安全口袋，负重也低。适合零风险熟悉地图，贵重物品别放进来。

obtain.en: You get it by deploying with a Free Loadout. Lance will swap one for a Combat, Looting or Tactical Mk. 1 at no cost, which is the best use of a spare. It also recycles into plastic and rubber parts, which is why it is worth keeping rather than dropping.
obtain.zh: 选择免费配装出战即可获得。兰斯可免费把它换成战斗、搜刮或战术 Mk. 1，这是多余一件时的最佳去处；也可回收出塑料零件和橡胶零件。

tips.en: Swap it for a Mk. 1 at Lance before you spend coins; the exchange costs nothing and the Mk. 1 lines hold more.
tips.zh: 先找兰斯免费换 Mk. 1 再考虑花钱，Mk. 1 的容量更大。

verdict.en: Mk. 1 is a learner bag; Mk. 2 is the cheapest way into Heavy Shields and a solid budget fighter.
verdict.zh: Mk. 1 是入门背包；Mk. 2 是最便宜的重型护盾入口，预算战斗首选。

use.en: Combat Mk. 1 only matters because it allows a Medium Shield early. Combat Mk. 2 adds a grenade slot, slow health regeneration and Heavy Shield support, so a Mk. 2 plus a Heavy Shield is the budget way to get 52.5% damage reduction. Tier lists rank it mid-pack: strong value, but outclassed once you can craft Epic augments.
use.zh: 战斗 Mk. 1 的价值就是早早能用中型护盾。战斗 Mk. 2 多一个手雷位、缓慢回血，并支持重型护盾，搭重型护盾是预算最低的 52.5% 减伤方案。榜单评价中游：性价比高，但能做史诗强化后就被超越。

obtain.en: Mk. 1: Lance sells it, or trade a Free Loadout Augment for it; the quest Down to Earth also rewards one. Mk. 2: craftable at Gear Bench 2, sold by Lance once a day, and Out of the Shadows rewards one. The wiki also lists Shani for Cred.
obtain.zh: Mk. 1：兰斯出售，或用免费配装强化兑换；任务“踏实补给”也给一件。Mk. 2：装备工作台 2 级可制作，兰斯每日限购 1 件，任务“走出阴影”也有奖励；维基还提到萨尼可用信用点购买。

tips.en: Mk. 2 repairs with just one Electrical Components and one Magnet, so it is cheap to keep running even after deaths.
tips.zh: Mk. 2 修理只要 1 个电子元件加 1 块磁铁，死几次也不心疼。

tips.en: Skip crafting Mk. 1 if you have a spare Free Loadout Augment; the exchange is free.
tips.zh: 有多余的免费配装强化就别做 Mk. 1，直接免费兑换。

verdict.en: The Heavy Shield fighter's bag: more regen than Mk. 2, a second grenade slot, and a big weight limit.
verdict.zh: 重型护盾玩家的背包：回血比 Mk. 2 更强，两个手雷位，负重高。

use.en: It is the combat augment to take if you want Heavy Shield tankiness, since it also takes Light and Medium. The 2 health every 5 seconds is slow and stops for 30 seconds after any hit, so it rewards disengaging between fights rather than winning fights alone. Players rank it a solid A-tier for mixed PvE/PvP, and the pick over Flanking for sustained fights.
use.zh: 想要重型护盾的肉度就用它，轻、中型护盾也都能装。每 5 秒回 2 点血很慢，受伤后暂停 30 秒，适合打完脱战恢复，别指望靠它赢团战。多数榜单评 A 级，持久战比侧翼突击更稳。

obtain.en: Craft it at Gear Bench 3 after learning the blueprint, which drops from augment and medical containers. Nerdschalk's farming list for blueprints: Stella Montis (Lobby Checkpoint Security, Sandbox, Archives), The Blue Gate (Confiscation), Buried City (Hospital), Dam Battlegrounds (Testing Addicts). It is not a quest reward.
obtain.zh: 学会蓝图后在装备工作台 3 级制作，蓝图出自强化和医疗类容器。蓝图推荐点：星辰山（大厅安检、沙盒、档案室）、蓝门（没收区）、掩埋废城（医院）、大坝战场（测试瘾君子）。没有任务奖励。

tips.en: Repair costs 1 Advanced Electrical Components and 2 Processors; don't take it into a raid you expect to lose.
tips.zh: 修理要 1 个高级电子元件和 2 个处理器，没把握就别带进必输的局。

verdict.en: A niche pistol pick: great space, but no Heavy Shield and a perk most builds never use.
verdict.zh: 小众手枪流选择：空间大，但没法装重型护盾，核心词条多数配置用不上。

use.en: The 33% faster equip only helps stowed Pistols and Hand Cannons, so it suits you if you swap to a sidearm for close fights. You also get the most Utility slots and 20 backpack slots, plus a Medium Shield since patch 1.29. Most rankings put it near the bottom of the Mk. 3 tier; Aggressive is better for general play.
use.zh: 加速只对收起的手枪和手炮有效，适合近身换手枪的打法。另有 20 格背包、更多功能位，1.29 起也能用中型护盾。多数榜单把它放在 Mk. 3 中下游，常规打法选进攻型更好。

obtain.en: Lance sells it, limited to one at a time, and you can also craft it at Gear Bench 3 once the blueprint is learned. Buying avoids hunting the blueprint, but check your coin first.
obtain.zh: 兰斯有售（限购 1 件），学会蓝图后也可在装备工作台 3 级制作。买最省事，不用刷蓝图。

tips.en: If you never carry a Hand Cannon or pistol, take Aggressive or Survivor instead.
tips.zh: 不带手枪或手炮就换进攻型或生存型。

verdict.en: Mk. 1 is a cheap bag upgrade; Mk. 2 is the best budget looter, with trinket slots and tick protection.
verdict.zh: Mk. 1 是便宜的背包升级；Mk. 2 是最好的预算搜刮包，带饰品位和防蜱虫。

use.en: Both only take Light Shields, so you trade defense for room. Mk. 2 has the highest weight limit and the most backpack slots of the Rare augments, three Trinket slots and a second Safe Pocket, and it flicks Ticks off after 1 second. Reviewers call it a strong budget looting choice that is easy to afford.
use.zh: 两者都只能装轻型护盾，用防御换空间。Mk. 2 在稀有强化里负重和背包格最多，有 3 个饰品位和第二个安全口袋，蜱虫 1 秒就甩掉。评测普遍说它是很好上手的预算搜刮包。

obtain.en: Mk. 1: Lance sells it, or swap in a Free Loadout Augment. Mk. 2: Lance sells one per day, it can be crafted at Gear Bench 2, and quests Celeste's Teenage Rebellion, In My Image and With A Trace give one. Shani also sells it for Cred.
obtain.zh: Mk. 1：兰斯出售，或用免费配装强化兑换。Mk. 2：兰斯每日限购，装备工作台 2 级可制作，任务“塞莱斯特的少年叛逆”“与我同形”“蛛丝马迹”有奖励；萨尼也可用信用点购买。

tips.en: A Light Shield plus Mk. 2 costs little to repair, so this is a good kit for running places with ticks.
tips.zh: 轻型护盾配 Mk. 2 修理很便宜，适合去蜱虫多的地方。

verdict.en: The biggest bag in the game at 24 slots, but Survivor beats it in most situations.
verdict.zh: 背包最大（24 格），但多数情况下生存型更强。

use.en: It takes Light Shields only. The Adrenaline Shot fires when your shield breaks on a fixed cooldown, and the built-in binoculars cannot be dropped. It works for solo scouts who avoid fights and want maximum space. Rankings put it in the B tier, behind Survivor.
use.zh: 只能装轻型护盾。护盾破裂时自动打一针弱效肾上腺素针剂（固定冷却），内置望远镜不可丢弃。适合躲战的单人侦察型玩家。榜单评 B 级，不如生存型。

obtain.en: Lance sells it, limited to one, and you can craft it at Gear Bench 3. It is not tied to a quest.
obtain.zh: 兰斯有售（限购 1 件），也可在装备工作台 3 级制作，没有任务奖励。

tips.en: The binoculars occupy a slot permanently, so factor that into your Quick Use layout.
tips.zh: 望远镜占用固定栏位，规划快速使用栏时要算进去。

verdict.en: Pick it when you must protect a weapon: its Safe Pocket takes any item and it supports all shields.
verdict.zh: 要保住一把武器时选它：安全口袋可放任何物品，三种护盾都能装。

use.en: The standout is a Safe Pocket that can hold a full weapon, so a good gun survives a death. Reviewers call it powerful but specialised; it doesn't beat Survivor for general looting. Good for dangerous events and high-risk PvP with a prized weapon.
use.zh: 亮点是安全口袋能放整把武器，阵亡后好枪也保得住。评测说它强但很专精，普通搜刮不如生存型。适合高风险事件和带着心爱武器的 PvP。

obtain.en: Reward for the quest Ruins and Reverberations; otherwise craft it at Gear Bench 3 after learning its blueprint. Blueprints come from augment and medical containers.
obtain.zh: 任务“废墟和回响”奖励；也可学会蓝图后在装备工作台 3 级制作，蓝图出自强化和医疗类容器。

tips.en: Only 18 backpack slots; keep loot light when you run it.
tips.zh: 背包只有 18 格，带它时少拿杂物。

verdict.en: The default Mk. 3 pick: the highest weight limit, three Safe Pockets and a downed-regen perk.
verdict.zh: Mk. 3 的默认之选：负重最高，3 个安全口袋，倒地可回血。

use.en: Almost every ranking lists it first: 80 weight, a Utility slot, and health that regenerates up to 75% while you are downed and stationary, which turns clutch revives into real chances. It handles Light and Medium Shields. One source mentions it may get a balance pass, so don't build your plans on it never changing.
use.zh: 几乎所有榜单都把它排第一：负重 80、有功能位，倒地静止时血量可回到 75%，让绝境救起更有机会。支持轻、中型护盾。有来源提到它可能被调整，别指望它永远不变。

obtain.en: Reward for the quest Bait, Fetch, Blast. The wiki lists the Black Crate as a source, and the blueprint lets you craft it at Gear Bench 3.
obtain.zh: 任务“诱饵、搜寻、爆破”奖励；维基列出黑色板条箱为来源，学会蓝图后可在装备工作台 3 级制作。

tips.en: Great for farming ARC bosses and for solo extractions with a full bag.
tips.zh: 适合刷 ARC 头目和单人满包撤离。

verdict.en: Mk. 1 is a learner bag; Mk. 2 is a favorite for PvP escapes thanks to its auto-smoke.
verdict.zh: Mk. 1 入门用；Mk. 2 的自动烟雾让它成为 PvP 逃生热门。

use.en: Tactical Mk. 1 is outclassed fast, but it gives five Quick Use slots and a Medium Shield. Mk. 2 drops a small smoke grenade whenever your shield breaks, which gives you a free break in line of sight, and one tier list puts it at S. The weight limit is the lowest of the Rare augments.
use.zh: 战术 Mk. 1 很快会被淘汰，但有 5 个快速使用位并可装中型护盾。Mk. 2 在护盾破裂时自动放出小烟雾，免费切断视线，有榜单评为 S 级。负重是稀有强化里最低的。

obtain.en: Mk. 1: Lance sells it, or swap a Free Loadout Augment; quest Trash Into Treasure also gives one. Mk. 2: Lance sells one per day, craftable at Gear Bench 2, and quests With a View and A Toxic Trail reward it.
obtain.zh: Mk. 1：兰斯出售或用免费配装强化兑换，任务“变废为宝”也给一件。Mk. 2：兰斯每日限购，装备工作台 2 级可制作，任务“风景如画”“有毒的踪迹”有奖励。

tips.en: Mk. 2 repair is one Electrical Components and one Magnet, so it is cheap insurance for PvP-heavy maps.
tips.zh: Mk. 2 修理只要 1 电子元件和 1 磁铁，PvP 多的地图很划算。

verdict.en: The sustain pick for Heavy Shield players: a built-in recharger that works while running.
verdict.zh: 重型护盾玩家的续航之选：内置充能器，边跑边用。

use.en: It comes with a reusable Shield Recharger on a cooldown and lets you use any Shield Recharger while sprinting. That makes a Heavy Shield much less painful in long fights and boss farms. Reviewers rate it A-tier and the pick for PvE and heavy-shield play.
use.zh: 自带可复用的护盾充能器（有冷却），还允许边跑边用任意充能器，重型护盾的持久战和刷头目更轻松。评测评为 A 级，PvE 和重盾首选。

obtain.en: No quest gives it and Lance doesn't list it. Learn its blueprint (from augment and medical containers) and craft it at Gear Bench 3.
obtain.zh: 没有任务奖励，兰斯也不卖。需从强化和医疗类容器找蓝图，再到装备工作台 3 级制作。

tips.en: Pair it with a Heavy Shield; the 2.0 durability decay cut makes that combo cheaper to keep alive.
tips.zh: 搭配重型护盾；2.0 降低了耐久损耗，这套更省修理。

verdict.en: A medic bag for careful players: three healing slots, three Safe Pockets, a revive cloud.
verdict.zh: 谨慎玩家的医疗包：3 个治疗位、3 个安全口袋，被救起时释放治疗云。

use.en: Three Healing slots let you carry far more meds and bandages, and the Cloud of Renewal fires when you are revived (45 health, 45-second cooldown in the current data). It takes Light and Medium Shields. Older posts quote 20 health and a 30-second cooldown; that is out of date.
use.zh: 3 个治疗位可多带药品，被救起时触发复苏云（当前数据为 45 点生命、45 秒冷却）。支持轻、中型护盾。旧文章写的 20 点、30 秒冷却已过时。

obtain.en: Lance sells it, limited to one, and these quests reward it: The First Nomads, A Reveal in Ruins, Prescriptions of the Past and On The Map. You can also craft it at Gear Bench 3.
obtain.zh: 兰斯有售（限购 1 件），任务“初代游民”“废墟中的揭示”“昔日的药方”“在地图上”均有奖励；也可在装备工作台 3 级制作。

tips.en: Best with a squad that revives you; solo it only helps after you are already back up.
tips.zh: 有队友救你时最有用，单人时只能在爬起后帮忙。

verdict.en: Squad and cautious-solo utility: a free defibrillator, but only Light Shields.
verdict.zh: 团队和谨慎单人玩家的实用包：自带复苏剂，但只能装轻型护盾。

use.en: The Integrated Defibrillator can be reused on a long cooldown (about 4 minutes per the community wiki), and you get slow regen too. It is a good support bag for teams. One guide finds its 5 Quick Use and 2 Safe Pocket slots restrictive and says it doesn't replace Survivor for looting.
use.zh: 内置复苏剂可重复使用，冷却很长（社区维基约 4 分钟），另有缓慢回血。适合当队伍的支援包。有指南认为它的 5 个快速使用位和 2 个安全口袋偏紧，搜刮上取代不了生存型。

obtain.en: Reward for the quest Waking the Grid, or craft it at Gear Bench 3 with the blueprint.
obtain.zh: 任务“唤醒安保网络”奖励，或学会蓝图后在装备工作台 3 级制作。

tips.en: It is one of the newer augments; verify the cooldown in-game before relying on it.
tips.zh: 这是较新的强化，依赖它之前先在游戏里确认冷却。

verdict.en: Mk. 2 with more room: same auto-smoke, two Utility slots, 19 backpack slots.
verdict.zh: 加大版 Mk. 2：同样的自动烟雾，2 个功能位、19 格背包。

use.en: It keeps the Mk. 2 smoke on shield break and expands capacity, with Light and Medium Shields. If you liked Mk. 2 and want more room, this is the upgrade. The wiki page is still a stub, so there is little community comparison yet.
use.zh: 保留 Mk. 2 的护盾破裂放烟雾，并扩大容量，支持轻、中型护盾。喜欢 Mk. 2 又想要更多空间就升级它。维基页面还是草稿，社区对比较少。

obtain.en: Craft it at Gear Bench 3 with its blueprint; no trader or quest sells it in the current data.
obtain.zh: 学会蓝图后在装备工作台 3 级制作；目前没有商人或任务提供。

tips.en: Recycling returns Advanced Electrical Components and a Processor, so a spare is not a total loss.
tips.zh: 回收可得高级电子元件和处理器，多余的也不亏。

verdict.en: The cheap default: no movement penalty, fits every augment, and almost free to repair.
verdict.zh: 便宜的默认款：不减速，所有强化都能装，修理几乎免费。

use.en: Charge 40 and 40% reduction. It costs speed nothing, so run it for scouting, loot runs and anywhere you expect to avoid fights. A shield absorbs a percentage of damage, so your health bar matters more than the charge.
use.zh: 护盾值 40，减伤 40%，不影响移速。适合侦察、搜刮、不想硬打的局。护盾是按比例减伤，真正的血量更关键。

obtain.en: Lance sells it, you can craft it at Workbench 1 or Gear Bench 1, and the quest Clearer Skies gives one. Free Loadouts also include one.
obtain.zh: 兰斯出售，工作台 1 级或装备工作台 1 级可制作，任务“清朗天空”有奖励；免费配装也自带一个。

tips.en: Repair is only 4 plastic parts, so patch it up every raid rather than replace it.
tips.zh: 修理只要 4 个塑料零件，每局修一修就行，不必换新。

verdict.en: The sweet spot for most raids: more charge for a tiny speed cost, and cheap to repair.
verdict.zh: 多数局的甜点：多一截护盾，只损失一点速度，修理也便宜。

use.en: 70 charge, 42.5% reduction and 5% slower. Take it when you expect fights, then step up to Heavy only if your augment allows it. Requires an augment like Combat, Tactical Mk. 2 or Survivor. The skill Used to the Weight eases the movement penalty.
use.zh: 护盾值 70，减伤 42.5%，减速 5%。预计有战斗时带它，强化支持再升重型。需要战斗、战术 Mk. 2 或生存型等强化。“负重如常”技能可缓解减速。

obtain.en: Lance sells up to 3 per day; the wiki also lists Raider Cache loot and Raider Decks. Several quests reward one (Exploring Pendola Pass, Bait, Fetch, Blast, Down to Earth, With A Trace, Out of the Shadows).
obtain.zh: 兰斯每日限购 3 个；维基还列了奇袭者箱和袭击者牌组。多个任务有奖励（探索彭多拉山口、诱饵、搜寻、爆破、踏实补给、蛛丝马迹、走出阴影）。

tips.en: Repair is 1 ARC Circuitry and 1 Battery per patch-up, well under the cost of a new one.
tips.zh: 每次修理仅 1 个 ARC线圈加 1 个电池，远低于买新的。

verdict.en: Best protection in the game, and cheaper to run since 2.0 cut its slowdown and wear.
verdict.zh: 最强防护；2.0 降低了减速和损耗，用起来更划算。

use.en: 80 charge and 52.5% reduction. Frozen Trail cut its movement penalty from 15% to 10% and its durability decay from 0.20 to 0.15. Only Combat Mk. 2, Aggressive, Safekeeper and Defensive can carry it. Take it for boss farming and contested loot, and a Defensive augment keeps it topped up.
use.zh: 护盾值 80，减伤 52.5%。霜痕小径（2.0）把减速从 15% 降到 10%，耐久损耗从 0.20 降到 0.15。只有战斗 Mk. 2、进攻型、守护者、防御型能装。适合刷头目和抢点，防御型强化可持续补盾。

obtain.en: Lance sells one a day for 16,500 coins; quests Celeste's Teenage Rebellion and Prescriptions of the Past give one. You can craft it at Gear Bench 2 with a Power Rod and 2 Voltage Converters, usually cheaper than buying.
obtain.zh: 兰斯每日限购 1 个，要 16500 钱币；任务“塞莱斯特的少年叛逆”“昔日的药方”有奖励。也可在装备工作台 2 级用 1 个能量管和 2 个变电器制作，通常比买便宜。

tips.en: Repairing costs 2 ARC Circuitry and a Voltage Converter, so only bring it when the raid is worth it.
tips.zh: 修理要 2 个 ARC线圈加 1 个变电器，值得的局才带。

tips.en: Salvaging in raid returns 4 ARC Alloy if you find one and don't need it.
tips.zh: 局内拆解可得 4 个 ARC合金，用不上可拆。

verdict.en: Cheap and plentiful, but weak against ARC armor; craft it rather than buy.
verdict.zh: 便宜量大，但打不穿 ARC 装甲；自己做比买划算。

use.en: It feeds the Kettle, Burletta, Hairpin, Bobcat and Stitcher. The wiki notes it struggles against ARC plating, so use it for raiders and soft ARC, and switch weapons for heavy robots.
use.zh: 用于“水壶”“布尔莱塔”“发夹”“山猫”“钉机”。维基提到它很难击穿 ARC 装甲，适合打雷袭者和软目标，打重型机器人要换武器。

obtain.en: Wasps and Turrets drop it, Raider Caches hold some, and Tian Wen sells it. A Workbench 1 craft makes 25 from 2 Chemicals and 3 Metal Parts. Quests Snap and Salvage and When Everything Falls give 100 each.
obtain.zh: 黄蜂和炮塔掉落，奇袭者箱也有，天玟出售。工作台 1 级用 2 化学品和 3 金属零件做 25 发。任务“拍照并拆解回收”“万物崩塌之时”各给 100 发。

tips.en: Carry roughly two full magazines' worth plus a stack for the raid; each round is almost weightless.
tips.zh: 带两三个弹匣量再加一叠，弹药几乎没重量。

verdict.en: The most useful all-round ammo: it feeds the most guns and punches through ARC better than Light.
verdict.zh: 最实用的通用弹药：能用的枪最多，对 ARC 的穿透也比轻型强。

use.en: It covers Arpeggio, Rattler, Tempest, Renegade, Torrente and more. Per the wiki it penetrates ARC armor much better than Light and a bit worse than Heavy, so it works for both raiders and drones.
use.zh: 适用“三连奏”“响尾蛇”“风暴”“叛逆”“奔流”等。维基称穿甲能力远胜轻型、略逊于重型，雷袭者和无人机都能打。

obtain.en: Hornets drop it (the wiki also lists Bastion), plus Raider Caches and Tian Wen. Workbench 1 turns 2 Chemicals and 3 Metal Parts into 20. Quests Picking Up The Pieces, Broken Monument and Back on Top give 80 each.
obtain.zh: 马蜂掉落（维基还列有堡垒），奇袭者箱和天玟也有。工作台 1 级用 2 化学品、3 金属零件做 20 发。任务“积少成多”“破败的纪念”“重占上风”各给 80 发。

tips.en: Crafting is cheaper than Tian Wen's price; stock a few stacks and keep a reserve in your stash.
tips.zh: 自己做比天玟卖得便宜，仓库留几叠备用。

verdict.en: Worth carrying for Anvil, Ferro and Bettina; you get 10 per craft, so stock up between raids.
verdict.zh: “铁砧”“生铁”“贝蒂娜”必备；每次只做 10 发，局间多备。

use.en: It beats Medium and Light against ARC armor; only explosive Launcher Ammo is better. Because slow heavy weapons burn rounds quickly, rely on crafting rather than hoping to find enough.
use.zh: 穿甲优于中、轻型，只有爆炸性的发射器弹药更强。重型武器耗弹快，靠自己做而不是碰运气捡。

obtain.en: Rocketeers and Sentinels drop it, Tian Wen sells it, and the wiki lists Raider Caches. Quests Sizing Things Up, The Right Tool, Communication Hideout and A Rising Tide hand it out. The stack grew from 40 to 60 in patch 1.26.
obtain.zh: 火箭手和哨卫掉落，天玟出售，维基还列有奇袭者箱。任务“审时度势”“正确工具”“通讯隐蔽处”“涨潮”会发放。1.26 版本把堆叠从 40 提到 60。

tips.en: One craft gives only 10 rounds for the same inputs as 25 Light, so each Heavy round is dearer; carry what you need, not more.
tips.zh: 同样材料轻型能做 25 发，重型只有 10 发，每发更贵，按需带。

verdict.en: Only for Il Toro and Vulcano; craft a small stock, since five per craft goes fast.
verdict.zh: 只给“公牛”和“火山”用；每次只做 5 发，备小量即可。

use.en: It beats Light Ammo against ARC armor but trails Medium. Shotguns are close-range tools, so take enough for a few engagements and don't hoard.
use.zh: 对 ARC 装甲强于轻型弹药、弱于中型弹药。霰弹枪是近战武器，带够几场战斗即可，不必囤积。

obtain.en: Shredders drop it, Tian Wen sells it, and Raider Caches have some. Workbench 1 makes 5 from 2 Chemicals and 3 Metal Parts. Quests Unexpected Initiative and Into the Fray give 40 each.
obtain.zh: 粉碎者掉落，天玟出售，奇袭者箱也有。工作台 1 级用 2 化学品、3 金属零件做 5 发。任务“计划不如变化快”“投入战斗”各给 40 发。

tips.en: The stack size is 20, so don't count on a full stack of ammo fitting in one slot.
tips.zh: 堆叠上限 20，别指望一格装很多。

verdict.en: Strongest anti-ARC ammo, but expensive: craft only when you are hunting big targets.
verdict.zh: 对 ARC 最强，但成本高：猎大型目标时再做。

use.en: Explosive payloads penetrate ARC armor better than Heavy Ammo. It is made for the Hullcracker (the wiki also lists the Rascal). Don't waste it on raiders you could shoot normally.
use.zh: 爆炸弹头的穿甲优于重型弹药。专为“裂甲者”设计（维基还列了 无赖）。不要浪费在普通雷袭者身上。

obtain.en: Bombardiers drop it, and the wiki also lists Turbine, Rocketeer and Rocketeer Husk. Tian Wen sells 6 for 4,500 coins with a daily limit since 2.0, which is steep. Crafting at Workbench 1 uses an ARC Motion Core and 2 Crude Explosives for 6 rounds. Boarding the Frigate rewards 3.
obtain.zh: 投弹手掉落，维基还列有涡轮、火箭手和火箭手残骸。天玟 2.0 起每日限购，6 发要 4500 钱币，很贵。工作台 1 级用 1 个 ARC运动核心和 2 个粗制炸药做 6 发。任务“登上护卫者”奖励 3 发。

tips.en: Buying is a last resort at that price; farm Bombardiers for cores and craft instead.
tips.zh: 这价格买只是下策，刷投弹手拿核心自己做。

verdict.en: Fuel for Jupiter and Equalizer: one clip fully recharges a weapon, and buying is capped, so craft.
verdict.zh: “木星”和“制裁者”的燃料：一个弹匣可完全充满一把武器，商店限购，所以自己做。

use.en: Each clip fully charges one weapon, and the wiki says energy weapons are never worse than Heavy Ammo at piercing armor. Carry one or two spare clips rather than a stack.
use.zh: 每个弹匣能完全充满一把武器，维基称能量武器的穿甲从不低于重型弹药。带一两个备用即可，不必成叠。

obtain.en: Harvesters and Vaporizers drop it (wiki). Tian Wen sells it at 3,000 coins, limit 20; since 2.0 that is a daily limit. The quest Furtive Meetings gives 5. Workbench 1 turns 1 Advanced ARC Powercell and 2 Batteries into 5.
obtain.zh: 收割者和汽化者掉落（维基）。天玟出售，3000 钱币，限购 20，2.0 起为每日限购。任务“秘密集会”奖励 5 个。工作台 1 级用 1 个高级ARC能量电池和 2 个电池做 5 个。

tips.en: Selling one yields only 200 coins, so use clips instead of selling them.
tips.zh: 卖一个才 200 钱币，留着用不如卖。

verdict.en: Cheap sideways-recoil fix; II is the sweet spot, III costs 30% ADS speed.
verdict.zh: 便宜的横向后坐力修正；II 最划算，III 要付出 30% 开镜速度。

use.en: It only trims horizontal kick, so it pays off on guns that drift sideways in bursts, like the Arpeggio and Kettle (guides pick III on the Arpeggio). Tier III slows aiming by 30%, which hurts in close PvP; players call that penalty fine for defensive or PvE play. If your gun mainly climbs, take a Vertical Grip instead.
use.zh: 它只削减横向后坐力，适合连发会左右漂的枪，比如“三连奏”和“水壶”（攻略给“三连奏”选 III）。III 会让开镜慢 30%，近距离 PvP 很吃亏，更适合防守或 PvE。如果枪主要是上跳，就换垂直握把。

obtain.en: Tier I is a starter craft at Gunsmith level 1 and Tian Wen sells it. Tier II and III need their blueprints and Gunsmith 2/3; Tian Wen also stocks them (limit 1 for III). Tier II is a reward for Marked for Death. All can be found by scavenging.
obtain.zh: I 级在武器工作台 1 级就能做，天玟也卖。II、III 需要先学会蓝图，并分别要求武器工作台 2/3 级；天玟同样出售（III 每日限购 1）。II 是任务“死亡标记”的奖励。三者都可在搜刮中找到。

tips.en: Tier I recycles back into 6 Plastic Parts, so crafting and recycling it costs you almost nothing.
tips.zh: I 级回收能拿回 6 个塑料零件，造了再拆几乎不亏。

tips.en: Do not stack it with a Horizontal Grip on the same gun; they share the underbarrel slot.
tips.zh: 它和水平握把共用下挂槽，不能同时装。

verdict.en: A retired Anvil mod in 2.0; keep it only if you need it for a project, otherwise recycle it for Amplified Fragments.
verdict.zh: 2.0 中已退役的“铁砧”改装；不是项目要用就回收成增强碎片。

use.en: It added 3 extra projectiles per shot at 70% less damage per projectile. In 2.0 Embark removed the Anvil's tech mod slot and turned the splitter into an Amplified upgrade branch (Amplified Anvil with Projectile Splitter), so this old mod is mostly a leftover item now.
use.zh: 它让每发多出 3 颗弹丸，但单颗弹丸伤害降低 70%。2.0 中“铁砧”的科技改装槽被移除，分流器改为增强升级分支（“增强型铁砧”分流器），所以这个旧改装现在基本是遗留物品。

obtain.en: The quest A Rising Tide gives one, and you can still scavenge it. The Trophy Display project is listed on the community wiki as using it, so check the project before recycling.
obtain.zh: 任务“涨潮”会给一个，搜刮也还能找到。社区维基称“战利品展示架”项目会用到它，回收前先确认项目需求。

tips.en: Recycling returns 5 Amplified Fragments, the material used to amplify weapons, which is worth more to most players than the 7,000 coin sale price.
tips.zh: 回收可得 5 个增强碎片，这是增强武器的材料，对多数玩家比卖 7000 钱币更有价值。

verdict.en: Core accuracy mod for semi-auto and burst guns; II is free of drawbacks, III adds wear.
verdict.zh: 半自动和点射枪的核心精度改装；II 没有代价，III 会加速磨损。

use.en: It shrinks bullet spread per shot and at maximum, so it helps most when you fire quickly and rely on hits at range. Guides name it for the Stitcher, Torrente and Anvil at III, and for the Renegade, Arpeggio and Kettle at II. Tier III burns durability 20% faster, which is why many players stop at II. If recoil climb is the problem, use a Muzzle Brake instead.
use.zh: 它降低单发散布和最大散布，快速连射、依赖远距离命中的枪最受益。攻略给“钉机”“奔流”“铁砧”选 III，给“叛逆”“三连奏”“水壶”选 II。III 耐久损耗快 20%，所以不少玩家停在 II。如果问题是枪口上跳，应该换枪口制退器。

obtain.en: Tier I is a reward from Market Correction and crafts at Gunsmith 1 from Metal Parts and Wires. Tier II is a reward from Broken Monument. Tier III has no trader or quest source in our data, so scavenge it or learn its blueprint and craft at Gunsmith 3.
obtain.zh: I 级是任务“矫正市场规则”的奖励，武器工作台 1 级用金属零件和导线就能做。II 是任务“破败的纪念”的奖励。III 在我们的数据里没有商人或任务来源，只能搜刮，或学会蓝图后在 3 级工作台制作。

tips.en: It shares the muzzle slot with Muzzle Brake, Extended Barrel and Silencer, so pick the one that fixes your gun's actual weakness.
tips.zh: 它与枪口制退器、加长枪管、消音器共用枪口槽，要选真正补你枪短板的那个。

tips.en: Reviewers say upgrading the gun itself comes before buying rare mods.
tips.zh: 多篇攻略都说，先升级枪本身，再考虑稀有改装。

verdict.en: A PvE and long-range mod; skip it for close fights, and III trades more vertical kick for velocity.
verdict.zh: 偏 PvE 和远距离的改装；近战别用，III 还会增加垂直后坐力。

use.en: It raises bullet speed and the distance before damage falloff, which makes leading moving ARC and distant targets easier. Guides recommend it on the Osprey and for an anti-ARC Renegade build. Tier III adds 15% vertical recoil, so I and II are the safer picks on guns that already climb.
use.zh: 它提高子弹速度和衰减前的射程，打移动中的 ARC 和远处目标更容易。攻略推荐用在“鱼鹰”和反 ARC 的“叛逆”配置上。III 会增加 15% 垂直后坐力，对本来就上跳的枪，I、II 更稳妥。

obtain.en: Tier I crafts at Gunsmith 1 with Metal Parts and Wires. Tier II and III need blueprints and Gunsmith 2/3. Tier III is also a reward from A Rising Tide, and everything can be scavenged. No trader sells it.
obtain.zh: I 级在武器工作台 1 级用金属零件和导线制作。II、III 需要蓝图和 2/3 级工作台。III 也是任务“涨潮”的奖励，各级都能搜刮。商人不出售。

tips.en: Ignore it on SMGs and shotguns; the range bonus rarely matters there (it does not fit shotguns at all).
tips.zh: 冲锋枪上基本不需要；霰弹枪根本装不上。

verdict.en: Free extra rounds with no drawback; always worth fitting on light-ammo guns.
verdict.zh: 没有任何代价的额外弹量，轻型弹药的枪都值得装。

use.en: It is a straight capacity bonus for the Bobcat, Burletta, Hairpin, Kettle and Stitcher. Guides call magazines a free win, and the Bobcat and Burletta builds include Light Mag III. The Hairpin has no other attachment slots, so this is its only upgrade.
use.zh: 这是对“山猫”“布尔莱塔”“发夹”“水壶”“钉机”的纯弹量加成。攻略把弹匣称为无代价提升，“山猫”和“布尔莱塔”的推荐配置都带轻型扩容弹匣 III。“发夹”没有其他配件槽，这是它唯一的升级。

obtain.en: Tian Wen sells I (limit 5) and II (limit 3). Tier I is also a reward from The Right Tool, A Better Use and Market Correction; Tier II from Snap and Salvage. Tier III has no quest or trader source in our data: scavenge or craft it at Gunsmith 3.
obtain.zh: 天玟出售 I（限购 5）和 II（限购 3）。I 也是任务“正确工具”“更好的用途”“矫正市场规则”的奖励，II 是“拍照并拆解回收”的奖励。III 在我们的数据中没有任务或商人来源，只能搜刮或在 3 级武器工作台制作。

tips.en: Tier III needs 5 Steel Springs; if you are short, II already gives +10 rounds.
tips.zh: III 要 5 个钢质弹簧；缺材料的话，II 已经有 +10 发。

verdict.en: The safest upgrade for medium-ammo rifles; craft II or III and move on.
verdict.zh: 中型弹药步枪最稳妥的升级；做到 II 或 III 就够了。

use.en: It adds capacity to the Arpeggio, Canto, Osprey, Renegade, Tempest, Torrente and Venator. Guides put Medium Mag III on nearly all of them, and testers call magazines a no-downside slot. It helps most on the Renegade, whose stock magazine is small.
use.zh: 适用于“三连奏”“颂歌”“鱼鹰”“叛逆”“风暴”“奔流”“复仇者”。多篇攻略几乎给每把都配中型扩容弹匣 III，并称弹匣是无代价的槽位。弹匣原本较小的“叛逆”受益最大。

obtain.en: Tier II is sold by Tian Wen (limit 5) and is a reward for Eyes on the Prize. Tier III is a reward for Collision Course and Outstanding Balance, or craft it at Gunsmith 3 with its blueprint. Tier I only comes from scavenging or crafting.
obtain.zh: II 由天玟出售（限购 5），也是任务“目光长远”的奖励。III 是任务“碰撞航线”和“未结债务”的奖励，也可学会蓝图后在 3 级武器工作台制作。I 只能搜刮或制作。

tips.en: Keep one spare Mod Component-based III for your main gun rather than fitting it on throwaway loadouts.
tips.zh: III 成本较高，留给主力枪，不要装在一次性配装上。

verdict.en: Must-have on the Il Toro and Vulcano: more shells means fewer reloads in a fight.
verdict.zh: “公牛”和“火山”必备：多装弹，少换弹。

use.en: It only fits the Il Toro and Vulcano. III adds 6 shells, taking the Vulcano from 4 to 10 according to one guide, and every shotgun build lists it with Shotgun Choke III. There is no drawback.
use.zh: 只能装在“公牛”和“火山”上。III 加 6 发，据一篇攻略，“火山”由 4 发升到 10 发，所有霰弹枪配装都把它和霰弹枪收束器 III 放在一起。没有任何代价。

obtain.en: Tier II is a reward for Eyes on the Prize. Tier I and III come from scavenging or crafting (III at Gunsmith 3 with the blueprint). Tian Wen does not sell any tier.
obtain.zh: II 是任务“目光长远”的奖励。I 和 III 来自搜刮或制作（III 需蓝图和 3 级武器工作台）。天玟不卖任何一级。

tips.en: If you only have one shotgun mod budget, spend it here before the Choke.
tips.zh: 预算只够一件霰弹枪改装的话，先买它，再考虑收束器。

verdict.en: Strong all-round recoil control, but the 30% ADS penalty makes it a steady-fire pick.
verdict.zh: 全面的后坐力控制，但开镜慢 30%，适合稳定射击。

use.en: It cuts both horizontal and vertical recoil by 30%, which beats Vertical Grip II for long bursts. Reviewers rate it fine for a stationary anti-ARC build, not for mobile fights. One guide pairs it with a Kinetic Converter on the Bettina.
use.zh: 水平和垂直后坐力各降 30%，长连发比垂直握把 II 更稳。评测认为它适合站桩打 ARC，不适合移动战。有攻略把它和动能转换器一起装在“贝蒂娜”上。

obtain.en: The quest Safe Harbor gives one, and you can scavenge it. It cannot be crafted and no trader sells it, so a found one is worth keeping for a main gun.
obtain.zh: 任务“安全港湾”奖励一个，也可搜刮。它不能制作，商人也不卖，捡到的值得留给主力枪。

tips.en: It fits 16 weapons but not the Renegade or Torrente.
tips.zh: 能装 16 种武器，但“叛逆”和“奔流”不行。

verdict.en: Looks great on paper, but most testers skip it: 15% fire rate costs 20% more recoil.
verdict.zh: 纸面好看，但多数测试者弃用：射速 +15% 要付 +20% 后坐力。

use.en: Only take it on a gun whose recoil you already control. Guides list it for the Stitcher, Torrente, Bettina and Vulcano. One tester advises against it on the Renegade, and the fire rate gain does not fix a gun's real weakness.
use.zh: 只在你已经压得住后坐力的枪上用。攻略把它列给“钉机”“奔流”“贝蒂娜”“火山”。有测试者不建议装在“叛逆”上，射速提升也补不了枪的真正短板。

obtain.en: You can only scavenge it; there is no recipe, trader or quest source in our data. The community wiki also lists it as used in the Trophy Display project (Part 1, Stage 3).
obtain.zh: 只能搜刮，我们的数据里没有配方、商人或任务来源。社区维基还称它用于“战利品展示架”项目（第 1 部分第 3 阶段）。

tips.en: If you do not need it for the project, recycling gives only 2 Duct Tape and 1 Mod Component; selling for 7,000 coins is better.
tips.zh: 项目不需要的话，回收只有 2 胶带和 1 改装零件，卖 7000 钱币更划算。

verdict.en: A speed mod for fast-swap or flanking play; it makes recoil much worse.
verdict.zh: 为快速切枪、绕后设计的速度改装；后坐力会明显变差。

use.en: ADS speed is boosted by 200% and equip time is cut 30%, at the price of 50% more vertical recoil and 50% longer recoil recovery. Guides put it on the Bobcat, Ferro and Osprey, and testers suggest it for secondary weapons or shotguns you fire and reposition with. Avoid it on a gun you spray with.
use.zh: 开镜速度 +200%，持枪时间 -30%，代价是垂直后坐力 +50%、后坐力恢复慢 50%。攻略给“山猫”“生铁”“鱼鹰”选它，测试者建议用在副武器或打了就换位的霰弹枪上。持续扫射的枪不要装。

obtain.en: Craft it at Gunsmith 3 (5 Duct Tape, 2 Mod Components) after learning the blueprint, or scavenge it. No trader or quest sells it.
obtain.zh: 学会蓝图后在 3 级武器工作台制作（5 胶带、2 改装零件），或搜刮。商人和任务都不提供。

tips.en: It sits in the stock slot with Padded Stock and Stable Stock; choose speed or stability, not both.
tips.zh: 它和减震枪托、稳定枪托共用枪托槽，速度和稳定只能二选一。

verdict.en: The go-to recoil mod for climbing rifles; II is the usual pick, III only for the Bettina-style heavy hitters.
verdict.zh: 对上跳严重的步枪是首选；II 最常用，III 主要给“贝蒂娜”这类重型枪。

use.en: Cuts both horizontal and vertical kick. Guides use II on the Bobcat, Burletta, Venator, Tempest, Rattler and Aphelion (no penalties), and III on the Bettina. Tier III burns durability 20% faster. Testers rank it above Compensator when climb is the problem.
use.zh: 同时降低横向和纵向后坐力。攻略把 II 用在“山猫”“布尔莱塔”“复仇者”“风暴”“响尾蛇”“远日点”上（无副作用），III 用在“贝蒂娜”上。III 耐久损耗快 20%。当问题是上跳时，测试者认为它比补偿器更好。

obtain.en: Tian Wen sells tier I (limit 5). Tier II is a reward for A Better Use, Collision Course and What We Left Behind. Tier III has no quest or trader source: scavenge or craft at Gunsmith 3 after learning the blueprint.
obtain.zh: I 级天玟出售（限购 5）。II 是任务“更好的用途”“碰撞航线”“遗留之物”的奖励。III 没有任务或商人来源，只能搜刮，或学会蓝图后在 3 级武器工作台制作。

tips.en: Do not craft III unless your gun is the Bettina; II gives most of the effect without extra repair bills.
tips.zh: 不是“贝蒂娜”就别做 III，II 效果接近，还不增加修理开销。

verdict.en: Solid stability for steady shooters; the slow ADS and swap make it a poor choice on shotguns.
verdict.zh: 给稳定射击型玩家的稳定性改装；开镜和切枪慢，不适合霰弹枪。

use.en: Recoil down 15% on both axes and spread down 20%, but ADS is 30% slower and equip is 20% slower. Guides use it on the Rattler and recommend skipping it on the Il Toro. One combo shown for the Torrente is Padded Stock with Kinetic Converter, but they share the stock slot, so check before copying it.
use.zh: 两个方向后坐力各降 15%、散布降 20%，但开镜慢 30%、持枪慢 20%。攻略用在“响尾蛇”上，并建议“公牛”不要装。有攻略给“奔流”推荐减震枪托加动能转换器，但两者共用枪托槽，照搬前先确认。

obtain.en: Tian Wen sells it for 15,000 coins (1 per day). Otherwise learn the blueprint and craft it at Gunsmith 3 with 5 Duct Tape and 2 Mod Components, or scavenge it.
obtain.zh: 天玟出售，15000 钱币，每日限购 1。也可学会蓝图后在 3 级武器工作台用 5 胶带和 2 改装零件制作，或搜刮。

tips.en: The 15,000 coin trader price is three times its value; crafting is far cheaper if you have the blueprint.
tips.zh: 商人价 15000 是它价值的三倍，有蓝图的话自己做便宜得多。

verdict.en: Tighter pellet spread for the Il Toro and Vulcano; III is the standard pick despite the extra wear.
verdict.zh: 给“公牛”和“火山”收紧弹丸散布；III 是常规选择，虽然更费耐久。

use.en: It lowers base spread, so more pellets land at range. Every shotgun build in guides runs Shotgun Choke III next to an Extended Shotgun Mag III. Tier III burns durability 20% faster, which is acceptable on a main shotgun. It takes the muzzle slot, so you cannot also use the Shotgun Silencer.
use.zh: 它降低基础散布，让更多弹丸在中距离命中。攻略里所有霰弹枪配装都是霰弹枪收束器 III 加霰弹扩容弹匣 III。III 耐久损耗快 20%，主力霰弹枪可以接受。它占用枪口槽，不能同时装霰弹枪消音器。

obtain.en: Tier II is sold by Tian Wen (limit 3) and rewarded by Marked for Death and Unexpected Initiative. Tier I and III come from scavenging or crafting (III at Gunsmith 3 with the blueprint).
obtain.zh: II 由天玟出售（限购 3），也是任务“死亡标记”和“计划不如变化快”的奖励。I 和 III 来自搜刮或制作（III 需蓝图和 3 级武器工作台）。

tips.en: Choke II is a cheap trader buy and has no wear penalty if you run shotguns casually.
tips.zh: 收束器 II 可以从商人处买，没有耐久惩罚，适合随手带霰弹枪。

verdict.en: A stealth option for solo shotgun farming runs; you give up the Choke's tighter spread.
verdict.zh: 单刷霰弹枪潜行的选择；代价是放弃收束器的聚拢效果。

use.en: It halves the noise of a shotgun blast without any other penalty, but it takes the same slot as the Shotgun Choke. Take it for quiet material runs on a busy map, and stay with the Choke if you hunt players up close.
use.zh: 不带其他惩罚，把枪声降低一半，但与霰弹枪收束器共用槽位。人多的地图上安静刷材料时带它，近距离找人对枪还是用收束器。

obtain.en: Craft it at Gunsmith 3 after learning the blueprint (2 Mod Components, 8 Wires), or scavenge it. No trader or quest provides it. It fits only the Il Toro and Vulcano.
obtain.zh: 学会蓝图后在 3 级武器工作台制作（2 改装零件、8 导线），或搜刮。商人和任务都不提供。只能装在“公牛”和“火山”上。

tips.en: Recycling returns only 1 Mod Component and 1 Wires, so keep it for builds you actually use.
tips.zh: 回收只返 1 个改装零件和 1 个导线，不用的话比卖掉更亏，按需留着。

verdict.en: Great for stealth and avoiding ARC aggro; II is the best value, III adds durability wear.
verdict.zh: 潜行和避免引来 ARC 的好选择；II 性价比最高，III 会加速磨损。

use.en: Cuts the noise you make. Guides pick II for the Renegade and Anvil and a silencer for the Ferro. It has no accuracy penalty, but it occupies the muzzle slot, so you give up a Compensator or Muzzle Brake. Tier III is 60% quieter but wears the gun 20% faster.
use.zh: 降低开火噪音。攻略给“叛逆”“铁砧”选 II，给“生铁”选消音器。没有精度惩罚，但占用枪口槽，要放弃补偿器或枪口制退器。III 噪音降 60%，枪磨损快 20%。

obtain.en: Tian Wen sells tier I (limit 1), a reward for When Everything Falls. Tier II rewards come from Snap and Salvage, Outstanding Balance and Market Correction. Tier III is scavenge-only with no recipe in our data.
obtain.zh: 天玟出售 I 级（限购 1），任务“万物崩塌之时”也会给。II 的奖励来自“拍照并拆解回收”“未结债务”“矫正市场规则”。III 只能搜刮，我们的数据里没有配方。

tips.en: Hairpin already has a built-in silencer, and the Hairpin cannot take any muzzle mods.
tips.zh: “发夹”自带消音，无法再装枪口改装。

verdict.en: One of the best mods for burst and semi-auto guns; the 20% slower swap on III hardly matters.
verdict.zh: 点射和半自动枪最好的改装之一；III 切枪慢 20% 基本无关紧要。

use.en: It shortens how long the reticle takes to settle after each shot. A tier list puts Stable Stock III at the top, and guides pick it for the Torrente, Arpeggio, Aphelion and Renegade (one tester found a III stock alone beats a full kit of weaker mods). Equip is slower, but on a primary weapon you seldom notice.
use.zh: 它缩短每发之后准星回稳的时间。有排名把稳定枪托 III 放在最前，攻略给“奔流”“三连奏”“远日点”“叛逆”选它（有测试者称只装 III 枪托就胜过一整套低级改装）。持枪变慢，但主武器上很少有感觉。

obtain.en: Tier I is a reward for A Better Use. Tier II is a reward for What We Left Behind. Tier III is sold by Tian Wen for 15,000 coins (limit 2) and is a reward for Back on Top, or craft it at Gunsmith 3.
obtain.zh: I 级是任务“更好的用途”奖励，II 是“遗留之物”奖励。III 由天玟出售（15000 钱币，限购 2），也是任务“重占上风”的奖励，或在 3 级武器工作台制作。

tips.en: Tier III is the one to save for: it costs 15,000 at the trader, so craft it once you have the blueprint.
tips.zh: III 值得投入：商人价 15000，学会蓝图后自己做更省。

verdict.en: The standard fix for rifles that climb; III is strong but its ADS penalty hurts in PvP.
verdict.zh: 上跳严重的步枪的标准解法；III 很强，但开镜惩罚在 PvP 中很吃亏。

use.en: It cuts vertical recoil by 20/30/40%. Guides recommend III on the Aphelion, Bobcat, Burletta, Venator, Tempest, Il Toro and Vulcano, and II on the Torrente. Tier III slows aiming by 30%; testers call it better for defensive or PvE play than for snappy PvP.
use.zh: 垂直后坐力分别降低 20/30/40%。攻略给“远日点”“山猫”“布尔莱塔”“复仇者”“风暴”“公牛”“火山”推荐 III，给“奔流”推荐 II。III 开镜慢 30%，测试者认为更适合防守或 PvE，不适合灵活的 PvP。

obtain.en: Tian Wen sells II (limit 5), which is also a reward for What We Left Behind. Tier I crafts at Gunsmith 1 from Duct Tape and Plastic Parts. Tier III needs its blueprint and Gunsmith 3, or scavenge it.
obtain.zh: 天玟出售 II（限购 5），“遗留之物”也会给。I 级在 1 级武器工作台用胶带和塑料零件制作。III 需要蓝图和 3 级武器工作台，或搜刮。

tips.en: Vertical Grip III recycles into 2 Mechanical Components and 2 Duct Tape, a decent refund.
tips.zh: 垂直握把 III 回收可得 2 机械元件和 2 胶带，返还不错。
